title: Jack profile (editable fields)
description: The fields update_profile edits. Hiring managers on the Jack network can see the profile. Experience and education entries are addressed by `key`.

headline.description: Short headline for the candidate (e.g., 'Senior ML Engineer'). Maximum 50 characters. Defaults to current job title. Generated by Jack, used only in presentation.
headline.title: Headline

detailed_summary.description: Jack's comprehensive markdown narrative of the candidate's career. Write as a markdown document with: 1) A professional summary paragraph (200-300 words), 2) A '## Career Timeline' section with structured entries for each role: '**Title at <employer> (From - To)**' followed by bullet points: first bullet describes what the company does, then subsequent bullets cover the candidate's responsibilities, achievements, and context. 3) An '## Education' section summarizing relevant education background. Should be 600-1000 words total. This field feeds ranking, so it must be sanitized: third person with they/them, no candidate name, no protected characteristics. Companies and institutions can be named; only swap a gender-revealing institution name for the degree and field.
detailed_summary.title: Detailed Summary

looking_for.description: 50-100 word description of what the candidate seeks, in third person. Salary expectations must not be included.
looking_for.title: Looking For

location.description: Free text describing candidate's location situation: where they live, work authorization, remote/hybrid preferences, visa status, and relocation willingness. Generated by Jack, must be sanitized.
location.title: Location

skills.description: List of key skills (technical and soft). Generated by Jack, used in embedding and labeler context.
skills.title: Skills

experiences.description: Work experience entries with 'key' for timeline_comments.
experiences.title: Experiences

links.description: Optional candidate-evidenced external links shown beside CV and LinkedIn.
links.title: Links

CompanyEnrichment.description: Company data enrichment for experience entries.
CompanyEnrichment.title: CompanyEnrichment

PackEducation.description: Education entry with stable key for timeline_comments.
PackEducation.title: PackEducation

PackExperience.description: Experience entry with stable key for timeline_comments.
PackExperience.title: PackExperience

PackLink.description: An optional candidate-owned external resource shown with their pack.
PackLink.title: PackLink
